findings.headline: Move this Solid web renderer static import.
findings.why: Solid 2 publishes the web renderer from @solidjs/web instead of the solid-js/web subpath.
findings.guidance: Do not move clearDelegatedEvents with the module source: delete the clearDelegatedEvents() call and dispose the render root instead, since delegated handlers now belong to each root. Nothing else in this statement moves to @solidjs/web.
